objective.name: sandbox.dsl.local.matter.chain
objective.description: Local DSL chain that builds params, writes a matter, reads it back, and consumes the written fields.

#root.role: Build a local record, write it into a local matter, read that matter back, and terminate through a local consumer wrapper.

effects.matter_write: One local matter revision is updated.
effects.matter_read: The newly written local matter is read back.
effects.local_wrapper_runtime: Local wrapper capacities build and consume the record.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local message becomes a consumed summary after one built record is written into a matter and read back.
invariants: The local matter write uses the record built by sandbox.build.record as the source of functional.message and functional.source_ctx.
The terminal wrapper consumes the committed matter fields returned by matter.read rather than the pre-commit built record.
success: The terminal payload exposes summary and ctx_id from sandbox.consume.record after the local matter round-trip.
The committed local matter revision stores the composed message and originating local context id.
failure: The flow fails if sandbox.build.record, matter.write, matter.read, or sandbox.consume.record cannot complete.
The flow fails if the local matter cannot be updated with the built record fields.
notes: This scenario is the local counterpart of the remote matter chain and validates committed local matter readback inside one DSL orchestration.
N7 validates both the terminal wrapper summary and the resulting local matter contents.
